Samuel Taylor Coleridge and Robert Southey, The Fall of Robespierre.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/samuel-taylor-coleridge_robert-southey/the-fall-of-robespierre

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Samuel Taylor Coleridge, the author, died 1834 (Wikidata Q82409; death 1834-07-25 in the facts file).
- Robert Southey, the author, died 1843 (Wikidata Q216838; death 1843-03-21 in the facts file).
- Ernest Hartley Coleridge, the annotator, died 1920 (Wikidata Q5393227; death 1920-01-01 in the facts file).

First publication of the text used: 1794 (SE colophon: 'The Fall of Robespierre was published in 1794 by Samuel Taylor Coleridge and Robert Southey')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1794, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin (not needed for this decision): every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (see the list above), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
